# ibee_network_sites (Data Source)

Authoritative VPC and reserved-IP site availability from the networking service. Select only entries with available=true. Compute site availability does not imply networking availability.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sites` | `list(object)` | Read-only |  |
| `sites.available` | `bool` | Read-only | Whether this networking service currently supports provisioning in the site. |
| `sites.message` | `string` | Read-only | API-provided explanation of site unavailability, when present. |
| `sites.name` | `string` | Read-only | Networking site_name returned by the API. |
| `sites.site_id` | `string` | Read-only | Canonical site ID accepted by networking APIs. |
